how_to_execute: `/next` picks the first pending task whose dependencies are met. Pilot: TASK-001 -> TASK-002 -> TASK-003 (HARD STOP, D7) -> TASK-004 (page) and, on PASS, TASK-005 (promote) -> TASK-006 (proof). Batches (on D7 PASS): the document tasks of a batch may run concurrently; then the batch's annex task (serial); then its sampled reading (HARD STOP, D8) and its proof; the next batch's document tasks start only after the reading PASSes. Then the batches' page and /ship. Every document task follows procedures/AUTHOR-A-DOCUMENT.md verbatim; the audit comes before anyone reads a draft.
